cited_by.title: Heavy periods by life stage and cause

record.population: Active component US Armed Forces women, 1998 to 2012
record.design: Surveillance analysis of medical records for menorrhagia
record.finding: Incidence was 6.2 cases per 1,000 person years and rose each year. Rates were highest in women aged 40 to 49 and in women of black, non-Hispanic ethnicity. Fibroids and ovarian cysts were the most common co-occurring conditions; under 1% of cases had a documented bleeding disorder.
record.note: Serving women only, diagnosed cases only. The abstract gives no count; I did not read the full report.
